source: Built-in ten-study example; intercept-only REML; supplied effect scale
plain: This analysis checked how much each of 10 studies affected the combined result. The pooled effect was 0.330 (standard error 0.069) on the supplied effect scale. 1 study met at least one influence flag. These flags identify studies to investigate; they are not reasons to exclude a study automatically. The analysis does not establish causation or clinical importance.
methods: An intercept-only inverse-variance random-effects meta-analysis used restricted maximum likelihood (REML) for the between-study variance. Within-study variances were the squared supplied standard errors. Effects were analysed on the supplied scale without transformation or back-transformation; ratio effects must already be on a log scale. Each leave-one-out analysis refitted the model and re-estimated the between-study variance. The forest plot uses 95% normal Wald confidence limits: the leave-one-out mean plus or minus the standard normal critical value times its standard error, without Hartung–Knapp adjustment. No pooled significance test, I² or prediction interval is computed by this app. Deleted studentized residuals use the omitted study variance, deleted-fit between-study variance and deleted mean variance. Hat values are random-effects weights divided by their sum. Cook’s distance is the squared change in the mean divided by the full-fit mean variance. DFFITS divides the change by the square root of the hat value times the sum of the omitted study variance and deleted-fit between-study variance. The covariance ratio is the deleted mean variance divided by the full-fit mean variance. DFBETAS scales the change by the square root of the full-design weight sum evaluated at the deleted-fit between-study variance. A study is flagged when absolute DFFITS exceeds three divided by the square root of the number of studies minus one, Cook’s distance exceeds the median chi-squared quantile with one degree of freedom, hat exceeds three divided by the number of studies, or absolute DFBETAS exceeds one. The Baujat plot uses squared Pearson residuals from the REML fit and influence on the pooled estimate; the radial plot uses the fixed-effect slope and a plus-or-minus-two reference band. Analyses were run in allmeta influence <build.version> (commit <build.shortSha>).
results: Across 10 studies, the full-sample pooled effect was 0.330 (SE 0.069). Between-study variance τ² = 0.0364; Cochran’s Q = 48.02 (df = 9). 1 study was flagged. Study rows below follow the order in the diagnostics table. flags: I² and a prediction interval are omitted because the app does not compute them. Influence flags require investigation of study methods and data.
